text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...!
Hehe... that's more like it.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
To think there was a girl in our generation who could run like that...
The world of milers really is vast!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Well, that's why the mile is the greatest, after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The result at the Asahi Hai FS was great, but it could hardly be called an easy win.
choice_data_list: Gran, you look pretty worn out...
Gran, you seem pretty worn out...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: *Sigh*... It's so hot!
choice_data_list: I've got a fan ready for you!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yay, this is itâª
Good job thinking 3 miles ahead!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Whew...
I just wanna take a bath and go to sleep...
choice_data_list: Then you should just head back to the hotel and sleep.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Huh? We can rest here? Didn't we check out this morning...?
choice_data_list: I've booked us for another night.
I've booked us for another night.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Whether we head back today or tomorrow,
I've prepared so that either works out fine."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Eeeh! Why, why?
choice_data_list: Well, it's because of my personal rule about electric fans.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—My personal rule!
"When your heart is burning up, bathe in the cool breeze of an electric fan!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Pheeew... It's piping hot...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day during training. Even though it was the dead of winter,
Gran Alegria was dripping with sweat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after sitting in front of the fan's strong blast for a while,
the sweat just wouldn't recede.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing that, I wondered if she often has trouble
shaking off feverish heat after a race, with fatigue hitting her all at once."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Races are far more physically and mentally draining than regular training."
choice_data_list: I thought that might be why you have your own rules.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I see! For me, it's just a personal rule because it feels kind of refreshing, but—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: All's well that ends well!
choice_data_list: By the way, extending my stay was an idea I got from Master.
By the way, extending my stay was an idea I got from Master.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"When traveling for away races, my mentor often returned the day after.
When I asked why, he said it was for the sake of
Umamusume who have trouble recovering from fatigue."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Wooww! Either way,
that's a 7-mile lifesaver!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, if we stay one more night,
we can eat takoyaki too♪
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's make sure we get plenty of rest before heading back!
Yeah. Let's rest up properly before heading home!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, upon returning to the academy, I immediately consulted with Master
to consider Gran Alegria's next race.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Next is obviously the Oka Sho, right!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: What's your plan?
choice_data_list: I'm thinking of the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Standard theory says to run a prep race before the Oka Sho. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She doesn't recover from fatigue very easily.
Wouldn't it be better to avoid wearing her out in a prep race, and head straight to the Oka Sho in peak condition?"

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I think that's fine. In Gran's case,
there's no need to clash with rivals beforehand anyway.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: The Oka Sho is a mile race, after all♪ As long as I run my race, I'll win!
choice_data_list: Alright, our next race will be the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm gonna surpass Ai-senpai!
Excited at 120 miles per hour~☆

text_block_list.name: Wavy Black-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, Gran.
Would you mind running alongside me later?”

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Huh? Me...? But Senpai, isn't your next race 1.5 miles?

text_block_list.name: Wavy Black-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I wanted to run against someone who's confident in their speed.

text_block_list.name: Wavy Black-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"The next race is overseas...
I have to win, no matter what!"

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Wait.
That is going way too far.

text_block_list.name: Wavy Black-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: However, I have to do at least that much...!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Then instead of running side-by-side,
let's make it a game of tag.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Gran, would you mind keeping me company?
After today's training menu is over is fine.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's fine!
Well then, Senpai, see you later!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for dragging you into this.
If I don't let her blow off some steam, she's going to burn out.
choice_data_list: Still, were you really okay with just playing tag?

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It makes for good light training.
Running yourself ragged when you're too wound up does more harm than good.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Training doesn't become more effective
just because it's agonizing, does it?

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: When you're in good shape and in the groove, it's healthier to run your heart out and build on it.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, you can't catch me~♪

text_block_list.name: Wavy Black-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Guh...! Wait!!
choice_data_list: This really trains your explosive power!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tag can be this effective when taken seriously.
Above all, she, who seemed so weighed down—

text_block_list.name: Wavy Black-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Or so you thought, take that!
Yaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: No waaaay! I couldn't hold the lead~!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Right? If you can have fun running and still get results,
isn't that better?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Passing down the lessons learned from my mentor to Gran Alegria.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I will do everything I can to escort her to the throne of the Oka Sho!
